items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...there was also the Prince George, who became King of England. He, too, was at a party.

ctx.x: I don't believe so. But I know what you did do, if you can remember. Well, I was thinking about the Prince of Wales, but there was also the Prince George, who became King of England. He, too, was at a party. As you say -- you said some millionaire, or some magnate, some tobacco magnate or something.
